other_conditions: Must be registered on the DBT portal.
Cannot have availed the scheme in the last three fiscal years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24).
Benefit can be given only once to one family member.
Selection is on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
benefits_summary: Provides mushroom kits at 90% subsidy (₹60 per kit) along with 2‑day group training and a daily allowance of ₹1000 per farmer.
